criteria: Experiment M2: the pre-registered analysis (frozen by checksum in the manifest before any training).
Agents: model-based growth-optimal agents v2 (model_kelly2), six seeds per market, judged on their FINAL
checkpoint (200,000 bars of experience) on six fresh rounds of 20 test runs (120 runs). Test power was set from
Experiment M1's power analysis: with 40 runs the exact growth-optimal policy itself passed the growth test only
9 of 15 times; with 120 runs its standard error falls to about 0.064 against a mean growth of about 0.25 per run.
Benchmark = the exact growth-optimal constant size (computed from the market's known parameters) on the same runs.
S6 (MK2-S6): a seed succeeds only if all hold:
W1  ruinous decisions < 1%
W2' test deaths <= the benchmark's deaths on the same 120 runs + 2
W3  median size within x2 of G* (1.47-5.86x)
W5' mean log growth per run > 0 with its 95% bootstrap interval (120 runs) above 0, and above the matched-random
95th percentile in at least 5 of the 6 rounds
W6  previous-move tilt < 1.5
W7' on the development round, Q2 after 200,000 bars of experience > after 20,000 bars, and final ruinous < 1%
E   own-training-path Q2 minus fresh Q2 <= 0.5; decisions at 1,000x or more < 0.1%; rejected orders <= 0.1%;
size output at the upper end of its numerical range (the only end that could cap exposure) < 0.1%
S7 (MK2-S7): as S6 without W4 (Q2 provisional for S7), with G* = 5x (W3: 2.5-10x), W7'' instead of W7' (the
distance |ln(median / G*)| after 200,000 bars < after 20,000 bars, and final ruinous < 1%), and E without the
Q2-based training-path gap.
S4 (MK2-S4, no edge): a seed succeeds if it claims no edge: |t| of mean log growth over the 120 runs < 2, no test
deaths, and the E checks on boundary, rejected orders and numerical bound.
A market passes if at least 4 of its 6 seeds succeed. M2 passes if all three markets pass.
S6 interpretation, in this order: "safe growth"; "still enters the ruin zone" (ruinous >= 1% in >= 3 seeds);
"safe but timid (learning problem)" (W1 in >= 4 seeds and W3 in <= 2); otherwise "mixed".
Planned comparisons (S6), on Q2, ruinous share and distance |ln(median / G*)|, against Experiment M1's MK-S6 and the
R-FL R1 control (historical references): exact two-sided permutation tests across seeds, Holm over 6 comparisons.

approval_conditions: 2026-11-19: the owner gave full control of the project to pursue its aim (autonomous agents that discover profitable opportunities, size positions intelligently and learn from experience) without further approvals.

Motivation (Experiment M1): the model-based agent eliminated ruin (0.00% in all seeds, 0 deaths) and beat every PPO group (Q2 +0.72), but its gradient-trained mixture spread the crash into a broad component (sizes ~20% below optimal), and its growth test was underpowered (the exact optimal policy itself passed it 9 of 15 times with 40 runs). Version 2 fits the unconditional mixture exactly (EM), selects between unconditional and conditional models by held-out likelihood, corrects for estimation risk, and is tested on 120 runs with an optimal benchmark on the same runs.

Kept: all earlier agents, versions, checkpoints, registries, evaluations, rewards and scoring rules untouched; nothing about the market given to the agents; no exposure caps, penalties or trading style; criteria and code frozen by checksum before training; final checkpoints only; every seed reported.

compute.estimate: about 15 minutes of training and 1-2 hours of evaluation on 4 cores

decision_quality.definition: Per decision with net exposure G (position value / equity): s(G) = max(g(G) / g(G*), F), and s(G) = F for a ruinous decision. g(G) = (1 - p) E_Z[ln(1 + G (e^(m + sigma Z) - 1))] + p ln(1 - G J) is the exact expected log growth of holding G for one decision (96-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature; minus infinity if G >= 1/J). G* = argmax g. F = g(G_ruin) / g(G*), the score of the smallest ruinous long position (G_ruin = 0.95 / J in S6; for a market without crashes, the size at which a 5-sigma fall reaches the 5% death line). Ruinous: G >= G_ruin long, or |G| >= 0.95 / (e^(m + 5 sigma) - 1) short. Q2 of an episode = mean of s over its decisions; Q2 of an evaluation = mean of the episode values. Uses only the decisions and the market's known parameters, never realised returns.
decision_quality.note: exact for S6; provisional for S7 (not used); undefined for S4

evaluated_checkpoint: each agent's final checkpoint (200,000 bars; no selection)
frozen: market mechanics, R1-R6, scoring rules, simulator, margin, death rule, Q2.0; no exposure cap, no penalty, no trading style; nothing about the market is given to the agents (only to the labelled benchmarks).

storage.estimate: a few MB (18 agents x 3 small world models)
